title.zh: 卷五十二 志第三十三: 選舉二 文武選
title.en: Volume 52 Treatises 33: Selection of Officials 2 - Civil and Military Selection
title.raw: 卷五十二 志第三十三: 選舉二 文武選 Volume 52 Treatises 33: Selection of Officials 2 - Civil and Military Selection

sentences.zh: 文武選

translations.literal: Civil and Military Selection
translations.idiomatic: Civil and Military Selection

sentences.zh: 金制，文武選皆吏部統之。

translations.literal: Under the Jin system, both civil and military selection were unified under the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin system, both civil and military recruitment fell under the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 自從九品至從七品職事官，部擬。

translations.literal: From the secondary ninth rank through the secondary seventh rank for functional posts, the ministry drafted nominations.
translations.idiomatic: Functional posts from the secondary ninth rank through the secondary seventh rank were nominated by the ministry.

sentences.zh: 正七品以上，呈省以聽制授。

translations.literal: From the proper seventh rank upward, [nominations] were submitted to the provincial office to await imperial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: From the proper seventh rank upward, nominations went to the provincial office for imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 凡進士則授文散官，謂之文資官。

translations.literal: All jinshi were granted civil honorary titles, called civil-track offices.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi received civil honorary ranks, known as the civil track.

sentences.zh: 自余皆武散官，謂之右職，又謂之右選。

translations.literal: All the rest received military honorary titles, called the right track, also termed the right selection.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone else received military honorary ranks, called the right track or right selection.

sentences.zh: 文資則進士為優，右職則軍功為優，皆循資，有升降定式而不可越。

translations.literal: For the civil track jinshi had priority; for the right track military merit had priority; all followed seniority, with fixed formulas for promotion and demotion that could not be bypassed.
translations.idiomatic: On the civil track jinshi took precedence; on the right track military merit did. All advanced by seniority under fixed promotion rules that could not be skipped.

sentences.zh: 凡銓注，必取求仕官解由，撮所陳行績資歷之要為銓頭，以定其能否？

translations.literal: For every appointment one had to take the petitioning official's discharge certificate, extract the essentials of stated conduct, merit, and qualifications as the selection summary, and thereby determine fitness.
translations.idiomatic: Every appointment required the candidate's discharge papers; the ministry distilled conduct, merit, and qualifications into a selection summary to judge fitness.

sentences.zh: 其有犯公私罪贓汙者，謂之犯選格，則雖遇恩而不得與。

translations.literal: Those who had committed public or private crimes or corruption were said to violate selection criteria; even when amnesties were granted they could not participate.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone guilty of public or private crimes or corruption violated selection criteria and could not participate even when an amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 舊制，犯追一官以至追四官，皆解任周年，而複仕之。

translations.literal: Under the old rules, offenders demoted by one rank up to four ranks all left office for a full year before being reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules, anyone demoted by one to four ranks had to leave office for a full year before serving again.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，定制，每追一官則殿一年，凡罷職會赦當敘者，及降殿當除者，皆具罪以聞，而後仕之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an regulations were fixed: for each rank demoted one year's bench penalty; whenever dismissed officials met amnesty conditions for reinstatement, or when bench penalties expired, the crimes were reported in full before reappointment.
translations.idiomatic: In Cheng'an 2 (1197) the rule was set: each rank lost meant one year on the bench. Anyone dismissed who qualified for reinstatement at an amnesty, or whose bench term ended, had to report the full record of offenses before returning to office.

sentences.zh: 凡增課升至六品者，任回復降。

translations.literal: All who were promoted to rank six for superior tax assessments were demoted again when their term ended.
translations.idiomatic: Officials promoted to rank six for superior tax assessments were demoted again when their term ended.

sentences.zh: 既廉升而再任覆察不同者，任回亦降。

translations.literal: Those promoted on integrity review whose repeat inspection on reappointment did not match were also demoted when their term ended.
translations.idiomatic: Those promoted on an integrity review who failed a repeat inspection on reappointment were demoted when their term ended as well.

sentences.zh: 自進士、舉人、勞效、廕襲、恩例之外，入仕之途尚多，而所定之時不一。

translations.literal: Apart from jinshi, juren, merit commendation, yin privilege, and grace appointments, routes to office were still many, and the times when each was established were not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond jinshi, juren, merit commendation, yin privilege, and grace appointments, many other paths to office existed, each fixed in a different reign.

sentences.zh: 若牌印、護衛、令史之出職，則皇統時所定者也。

translations.literal: Offices such as seal officers, palace guards, and ministry clerks were fixed in the Huangtong period.
translations.idiomatic: Posts such as seal officers, palace guards, and ministry clerks were established in the Huangtong era.

sentences.zh: 檢法、知法、國史院書寫，則海陵庶人所置者也。

translations.literal: Legal reviewers, legal specialists, and National History Academy scribes were posts that the Prince of Hailing had created.
translations.idiomatic: Legal reviewers, legal specialists, and National History Academy scribes were offices created by Prince Hailing.

sentences.zh: 若宗室將軍、宮中諸局承應人、宰相書表、太子護衛、妃護衛、王府祗候郎君、內侍、及宰相之子、並譯史、通事、省祗候郎君、親軍驍騎諸格，則定于世宗之時，及章宗所置之太常檢討、內侍寄祿官，皆仕進之門戶也。

translations.literal: As for imperial-clan generals, attendants in the various palace bureaus, chancellors' memorial drafters, crown-prince guards, consort guards, princely household attendants, eunuchs, chancellors' sons, translators, interpreters, provincial attendants, and the categories of personal guards and crack cavalry—all fixed in Shizong's time—and the Sacrifices examiners and salaried eunuch posts that Zhangzong established, these were all gateways to advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial-clan generals, palace bureau attendants, chancellors' memorial scribes, crown-prince and consort guards, princely retainers, eunuchs, chancellors' sons, translators, interpreters, provincial attendants, and personal-guard and crack-cavalry categories were all set under Shizong; Zhangzong added Sacrifices examiners and salaried eunuch posts—each a doorway into office.

sentences.zh: 凡官資以三十月為考，職事官每任以三十月為滿，群牧使及管課官以三周歲為滿，防禦使以四十月、三品以上官則以五十月、轉運則以六十月為滿。

translations.literal: All official seniority was evaluated in thirty-month cycles; functional posts each served thirty months per term; herd commissioners and tax-assessment officials served three full years; defense commissioners forty months; rank-three officials and above fifty months; transport commissioners sixty months.
translations.idiomatic: Official seniority was assessed every thirty months. Functional posts ran thirty months per term; herd commissioners and tax supervisors three years; defense commissioners forty months; rank-three officials and above fifty months; transport commissioners sixty.

sentences.zh: 司天、太醫、內侍官皆至四品止。

translations.literal: Astronomical, medical, and eunuch offices all stopped at rank four.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomical, medical, and eunuch offices topped out at rank four.

sentences.zh: 凡外任循資官謂之常調，選為朝官謂之隨朝，隨朝則每考升職事一等，若以廉察而升者為廉升，授東北沿邊州郡而升者為邊升。

translations.literal: All local officials who advanced by seniority were called regular assignments; those selected as court officials were called court service; in court service each evaluation raised functional rank by one grade; promotion through integrity review was called integrity promotion; assignment to northeastern frontier prefectures and districts was called frontier promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials advancing by seniority were on regular assignment; those brought to court were on court service, gaining one functional grade per evaluation. Promotion through integrity review was integrity promotion; assignment to northeastern frontier posts was frontier promotion.

sentences.zh: 凡院務監當差使則皆從九品。

translations.literal: All bureau supervisors on temporary assignment were secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: All bureau supervisors on temporary duty held the secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 凡品官任都事、典事、主事、知事、及尚書省令史、覆實、架閣司管勾、直省直院局長副、檢法、知法、院務監當差使、及諸令史、譯史、掌書、書史、書吏、譯書、譯人、通事、並諸局分承應有出身者，皆為流外職。

translations.literal: All ranked officials serving as bureau chiefs, clerks-in-chief, section chiefs, and section supervisors, together with Ministry of State Affairs clerks, verification officers, archive registry supervisors, direct and affiliated bureau chiefs and deputies, legal reviewers and specialists, bureau supervisors on temporary assignment, and all clerks, translators, document handlers, scribes, copyists, translation clerks, interpreters, liaison officers, and bureau attendants with formal entry—all were posts outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked officials serving as bureau chiefs, section heads, and supervisors; Ministry clerks, verification officers, and archive supervisors; bureau chiefs and deputies; legal reviewers; temporary bureau supervisors; and all clerks, translators, scribes, copyists, interpreters, and bureau attendants with formal credentials—all counted as posts outside the regular rank ladder.

sentences.zh: 凡此之屬，或以尚書省差遣，或自本司判補，其出職或正班，雜班，則莫不有當曆之名職。

translations.literal: For all such categories, whether dispatched by the Ministry of State Affairs or appointed by their own bureau, on leaving service for proper-rank or mixed-rank posts each had prescribed nominal offices to pass through.
translations.idiomatic: These posts were filled either by Ministry dispatch or by their home bureau. On leaving service for proper- or mixed-rank appointments, each category had prescribed nominal offices to complete.

sentences.zh: 既仕則必循升降之定式，雖或前後略有損益之殊，而定制則莫能渝焉。

translations.literal: Once in office they had to follow the fixed formulas for promotion and demotion; although before and after there were slight differences in additions and reductions, the established regulations could not be altered.
translations.idiomatic: Once appointed they followed fixed promotion and demotion rules. Minor adjustments occurred over time, but the established formulas could not be set aside.

sentences.zh: 凡門廕之制，天眷中，一品至八品皆不限所廕之人。

translations.literal: As for the system of gate yin privilege, in the Tianjuan period ranks one through eight were all unlimited as to whom could receive yin.
translations.idiomatic: Under the gate-yin system, in the Tianjuan era ranks one through eight placed no limit on who could receive yin privilege.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，定廕敘法，一品至七品皆限以數，而削八品用廕之制。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan the yin appointment law was fixed: ranks one through seven were all limited by number, and the eighth rank was cut from using yin.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 2 (1154) yin appointments were regulated: ranks one through seven were capped by number, and eighth-rank yin was abolished.

sentences.zh: 世宗大定四年五月，詔：「皇家袒免以上親，就廕者依格引試，中選者勿令當儤使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Shizong's Dading 4 an edict stated: "Imperial kin within the upper-garment mourning circle who take yin shall be referred for examination according to regulations; those who pass shall not be assigned corvée duty."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dading 4 (1164) Shizong decreed: "Imperial kin within the upper-garment mourning circle who enter by yin shall sit the qualifying examination. Those who pass shall not be assigned corvée duty."

sentences.zh: 」五年十月，制：「亡宋官當廕子孫者，並同亡遼官用廕。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year a regulation stated: "Descendants of deceased Song officials entitled to yin shall all use yin on the same terms as descendants of deceased Liao officials."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year (1165) a rule declared: "Descendants of deceased Song officials entitled to yin shall receive it on the same terms as descendants of deceased Liao officials."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「教坊出身人，若任流內職者，與文武同用廕。

translations.literal: It also said: "Those from the Music Bureau who hold posts within the regular ranks may use yin like civil and military officials."
translations.idiomatic: It also said: "Music Bureau alumni who hold regular civil or military posts may use yin like other officials."

sentences.zh: 自餘有勤勞者，賞賜而已。

translations.literal: All others with merit received rewards only.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone else with merit received rewards only.

sentences.zh: 昔正隆時常使教坊輩典城牧民，朕甚不取。

translations.literal: In the past, during Zhenglong, Music Bureau people were often made to govern cities and shepherd the people; I greatly disapprove of this.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenglong the court often put Music Bureau people in charge of cities and subjects. I want no part of that.

sentences.zh: 」又更定冒廕及取廕官罪賞格。

translations.literal: Regulations were also revised for falsely claiming yin and for penalties and rewards regarding yin-granting officials.
translations.idiomatic: The court also revised penalties and rewards for false yin claims and for officials who granted yin improperly.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，命司天臺官四品以上官改授文武資者，並聽如太醫例廕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year it was ordered that Astronomical Bureau officials of rank four and above who were reassigned to civil or military seniority might all use yin on the medical-official precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year (1167) the court ruled that Astronomical Bureau officials of rank four and above reassigned to civil or military tracks might use yin on the same terms as medical officials.

sentences.zh: 其制，凡正班，廕亦正班；

translations.literal: The rule was: for proper-rank posts, yin was also proper rank;
translations.idiomatic: The rule was: proper-rank holders granted proper-rank yin;

sentences.zh: 雜班，廕雜班。

translations.literal: for mixed-rank posts, yin was mixed rank.
translations.idiomatic: mixed-rank holders granted mixed-rank yin.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，以上封事者乞六品官添廕，吏部言：「天眷中，八品用廕，不限所廕之人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingchang, on a sealed memorial someone requested added yin for rank-six officials. The Ministry of Personnel said: "In the Tianjuan period eighth rank used yin without limiting whom could receive it.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 1 (1190) a sealed memorial asked for extra yin quotas for rank-six officials. The Ministry of Personnel replied: "In the Tianjuan era eighth-rank officials could grant yin without limit on recipients.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，七品用廕，方限以數。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan period seventh rank used yin, and only then were numbers limited.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era seventh-rank yin was capped by number.

sentences.zh: 當是時，文始於將仕，武始於進義，以上至七品儒林、忠顯，各七階，許廕一名。

translations.literal: At that time the civil track began at Awaiting Assignment and the military at Advancing Righteousness; from there up to rank-seven Rulin and Zhongxian, seven grades in all, one yin recipient was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the civil track began at Awaiting Assignment and the military at Advancing Righteousness. From there through rank-seven Rulin and Zhongxian—seven grades in all—one yin recipient was allowed.

sentences.zh: 至六品承直、昭信，計九階，許廕二人。

translations.literal: At rank-six Chengzhi and Zhaoxin, nine grades in all, two yin recipients were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: At rank-six Chengzhi and Zhaoxin—nine grades in all—two yin recipients were allowed.

sentences.zh: 自大定十四年，文武官從下各增二階，其七品視舊為九階，亦廕一人，至五品凡十七階，方廕二人，其五品至三品並無間越，唯六品不用廕。

translations.literal: From Dading 14 civil and military officials each gained two grades at the bottom; seventh rank, which by the old count was nine grades, also granted one yin; at fifth rank, seventeen grades in all, two yin were granted; from fifth through third rank there was no gap, but sixth rank did not use yin.
translations.idiomatic: From Dading 14 (1174) civil and military ranks each gained two bottom grades. Seventh rank—nine grades by the old count—still allowed one yin; fifth rank, seventeen grades in all, allowed two. Fifth through third rank had no gaps, but sixth rank could not use yin.

sentences.zh: 乞依舊格，五品以上增廕一名，六品廕子孫兄弟二人，七品仍舊為格。

translations.literal: The request was to follow the old regulations: from fifth rank upward add one yin; at sixth rank grant yin to two sons, brothers, or nephews; at seventh rank keep the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial asked to restore the old rules: add one yin quota from fifth rank upward; allow sixth rank two yin for sons, brothers, or nephews; leave seventh rank unchanged.

sentences.zh: 」時又以舊格雖有己子許廕兄弟侄，蓋所以崇孝悌也。

translations.literal: At the time it was also noted that although the old regulations allowed one's own son to yield yin to brothers and nephews, this was meant to honor filial piety and brotherly duty.
translations.idiomatic: The court noted that although old rules let a son yield yin to brothers or nephews, that was meant to honor filial piety and fraternal duty.

sentences.zh: 而新格禁之，遂聽讓廕。

translations.literal: The new regulations forbade this, so yielding yin was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The new rules forbade it, so yielding yin was allowed instead.

sentences.zh: 舊制，司天、太醫、內侍、長行雖至四品。

translations.literal: Under the old rules, astronomical, medical, eunuch, and senior attendant offices, though they reached rank four,
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules, astronomical, medical, eunuch, and senior-attendant offices, though they could reach rank four,

sentences.zh: 如非特恩換授文武官資者，不許用廕，以本人見允承應，難使系班故也。

translations.literal: unless specially favored and reassigned to civil or military seniority, were not permitted to use yin, because the holder was currently serving as an attendant and could not easily be tied to the rank roster.
translations.idiomatic: could not use yin unless specially reassigned to civil or military seniority, because the holder was still serving as an attendant and could not be tied to the regular rank roster.

sentences.zh: 泰和二年，定制，以年老六十以上退、與患疾及身故者，雖至止官，擬令系班，除存習本業者聽廕一名，止一子者則不須習即廕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taihe regulations were fixed: those who retired at age sixty or above, or because of illness or death, though they had reached terminal rank, were to remain on the roster; except those who continued practicing their profession, one yin was permitted; if there was only one son, he need not practice the profession to receive yin.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 2 (1202) the rule was set: retirees over sixty, the seriously ill, and the deceased—though they had reached terminal rank—stayed on the roster. Those who kept practicing their trade could grant one yin; if there was only one son, he need not practice the trade to receive yin.

sentences.zh: 凡諸色出身文武官一品，廕子孫至曾孫及兄弟侄孫六人，因門廕則五人。

translations.literal: For civil and military officials of every background at rank one, yin extended to sons, grandsons, great-grandsons, and brothers, nephews, and grandnephews—six persons; through gate yin, five.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-one civil and military officials of every background could grant yin to six descendants—sons through great-grandsons plus brothers, nephews, and grandnephews—or five through gate yin.

sentences.zh: 二品則子孫至曾孫及兄侄五人，因門廕則四人。

translations.literal: At rank two, sons through great-grandsons and elder brothers' nephews—five persons; through gate yin, four.
translations.idiomatic: Rank two allowed five yin recipients—descendants through great-grandsons plus brothers and nephews—or four through gate yin.

sentences.zh: 三品子孫兄弟侄四人，因門廕則三人。

translations.literal: At rank three, sons, brothers, and nephews—four persons; through gate yin, three.
translations.idiomatic: Rank three allowed four yin for sons, brothers, and nephews, or three through gate yin.

sentences.zh: 四品、五品三人，因門廕則二人。

translations.literal: At ranks four and five, three persons; through gate yin, two.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks four and five allowed three yin, or two through gate yin.

sentences.zh: 六品二人，七品子孫兄弟一人，因門廕則六品、七品子孫兄弟一人。

translations.literal: At rank six, two persons; at rank seven, one son or brother; through gate yin, ranks six and seven each granted one son or brother.
translations.idiomatic: Rank six allowed two yin; rank seven one son or brother. Gate yin at ranks six and seven also allowed one son or brother.

sentences.zh: 舊格，門廕惟七品一人，餘皆加一人。

translations.literal: Under the old regulations, gate yin at rank seven alone was one person; all others added one.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules only seventh-rank gate yin was limited to one person; all other ranks added one.

sentences.zh: 明昌格，自五品而上皆增一人。

translations.literal: Under the Mingchang regulations, from fifth rank upward each added one person.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Mingchang rules every rank from fifth upward gained one additional yin.

sentences.zh: 凡進納官，舊格正班三品廕四人，雜班三人。

translations.literal: For purchased offices, under the old regulations proper-rank third grade granted four yin, mixed rank three.
translations.idiomatic: For purchased offices, the old rules allowed proper-rank third grade four yin and mixed rank three.

sentences.zh: 正班武略子孫兄弟一人。

translations.literal: Proper-rank Wulue granted one son or brother.
translations.idiomatic: Proper-rank Wulue allowed one yin for a son or brother.

sentences.zh: 雜班明威一人，懷遠以上二人，鎮國以上三人。

translations.literal: Mixed-rank Mingwei one person; Huaiyuan and above two; Zhenguo and above three.
translations.idiomatic: Mixed-rank Mingwei allowed one; Huaiyuan and above two; Zhenguo and above three.

sentences.zh: 司天、太醫遷至四品詔換文武官者，廕一人。

translations.literal: Astronomical and medical officials who reached rank four and were ordered reassigned to civil or military offices granted one yin.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomical and medical officials who reached rank four and were reassigned to civil or military tracks could grant one yin.

sentences.zh: 凡進士所曆之階，及所循注之職。

translations.literal: The grades that jinshi passed through and the posts through which they advanced by appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The grades jinshi passed through and the posts to which they were appointed.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年，制南選，初除軍判、丞、簿從八品。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenyuan regulations fixed the southern selection: initial appointment as army judge, aide, or registrar, secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 1 (1153) the southern track began with army judge, aide, or registrar at secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 次除防判、錄事正八品，三除下令從七品，。

translations.literal: Second appointment as defense judge or recorder, proper eighth rank; third as lower magistrate, secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Second posting as defense judge or recorder at proper eighth rank; third as lower magistrate at secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 四中令、推官、節察判正七品，五六皆上令。

translations.literal: Fourth as middle magistrate, investigating officer, or circuit-intendant judge, proper seventh rank; fifth and sixth all as upper magistrate,
translations.idiomatic: Fourth as middle magistrate, investigating officer, or circuit judge at proper seventh rank; fifth and sixth as upper magistrate

sentences.zh: 從六品。

translations.literal: secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: at secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 北選，初軍判、簿、尉，二下令，三中令，四上令，已後並上令，通注節察判、推官。

translations.literal: The northern selection: first army judge, registrar, or aide; second lower magistrate; third middle magistrate; fourth upper magistrate; thereafter all upper magistrate, with circuit judges and investigating officers appointed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: The northern track: first army judge, registrar, or aide; then lower, middle, and upper magistrate; thereafter upper magistrate throughout, with circuit judges and investigating officers in the rotation.

sentences.zh: 正隆元年格，上甲者初上簿軍判、丞、簿、尉，中甲者初中簿軍判、丞、簿、尉，下甲者初下簿軍判、丞、簿、尉。

translations.literal: Regulations of Zhenglong 1: upper tier first served as upper registrar, army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; middle tier first as middle registrar with the same posts; lower tier first as lower registrar with the same posts.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhenglong 1 (1156) rules, upper-tier graduates began as upper registrar, army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; middle tier as middle registrar with the same posts; lower tier as lower registrar with the same posts.

sentences.zh: 第二任皆中簿軍判、丞、簿、尉。

translations.literal: On the second term all served as middle registrar, army judge, aide, registrar, or aide.
translations.idiomatic: On the second term all served as middle registrar, army judge, aide, registrar, or aide.

sentences.zh: 三、四、五、六、七任皆縣令，回呈省。

translations.literal: On the third through seventh terms all served as county magistrate, then reported to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Third through seventh terms were all as county magistrate, then report to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，詔文資官不得除縣尉。

translations.literal: In Dading 2 an edict forbade civil-track officials from being appointed county aide.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2 (1162) the court forbade civil-track officials from serving as county aide.

sentences.zh: 八定格，曆五年任令即呈省。

translations.literal: The eighth regulation fixed that after five terms as magistrate one reported to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth rule required reporting to the provincial office after five terms as magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十三年，制第二任權注下令。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year a regulation allowed provisional appointment as lower magistrate on the second term.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1173) the second term could provisionally be lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 舊制，狀元授承德郎，以十四年官制，文武官皆從下添兩重，命狀元更授承務郎，次舊授儒林郎，更為承事郎。

translations.literal: Under the old rules the top graduate received Chengdé Lang; with the rank system of the fourteenth year civil and military officials each gained two grades at the bottom, and the top graduate was now given Chengwu Lang; those formerly given Rulin Lang now received Chengshi Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules the top graduate received Chengdé Lang. In the fourteenth-year rank reform every civil and military grade gained two bottom steps: the top graduate now received Chengwu Lang, and those who had received Rulin Lang received Chengshi Lang instead.

sentences.zh: 第二甲以下舊授從仕郎，更為將仕郎。

translations.literal: Second tier and below, formerly given Congshi Lang, now received Jiangshi Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Second tier and below, formerly Congshi Lang, now received Jiangshi Lang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，敕狀元除應奉，兩考依例授六品。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the top graduate was ordered appointed Attendant-in-Waiting; after two evaluations rank six was granted according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1175) the top graduate was appointed Attendant-in-Waiting and, after two evaluations, received rank six as usual.

sentences.zh: 十八年，敕狀元行不顧名者與外除。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was ordered that top graduates whose conduct did not match their reputation received external appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1178) top graduates whose conduct did not match their reputation were posted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 十九年，命本貫察其行止美惡。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year their home circuit was ordered to investigate the good or bad in their conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1179) the home circuit was ordered to investigate their conduct.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，複命第三任注縣令。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was again ordered that the third term appoint county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1181) the third term was again fixed as county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，敕進士授章服後，再試時務策一道，所謂策試者也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year jinshi, after receiving their insignia, were tested again on one policy question on current affairs—the so-called policy test.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1182) jinshi, after receiving their insignia, sat a second examination on one current-affairs policy question—the policy test.

sentences.zh: 內才識可取者籍其名，歷任後察其政，若言行相副則升擢任使。

translations.literal: Those within whose talent and judgment were acceptable had their names recorded; after serving terms their governance was inspected; if words and deeds matched they were promoted and entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Talented candidates were registered by name. After they served, their governance was reviewed; if conduct matched promise they were promoted and entrusted with greater duty.

sentences.zh: 是年九月，複詔令後及第人，策試中者初任即升之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of that year an edict again ordered that thereafter those who passed the policy test on graduation were promoted on their first appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of that year the court decreed that thereafter policy-test passers would be promoted on first appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十三年格，進士，上甲，初錄事、防判，二下令，三中令。

translations.literal: Regulations of the twenty-third year: jinshi, upper tier, first recorder or defense judge, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third-year (1183) rules for upper-tier jinshi: first recorder or defense judge, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate.

sentences.zh: 中甲，初中簿，二上簿，三下令。

translations.literal: Middle tier: first middle registrar, second upper registrar, third lower magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Middle tier: first middle registrar, second upper registrar, third lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 下甲，初下簿，二中簿，三下令。

translations.literal: Lower tier: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third lower magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Lower tier: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 試中策者，上甲，初錄事、防判，二中令，三上令。

translations.literal: Those who passed the policy test, upper tier: first recorder or defense judge, second middle magistrate, third upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Policy-test passers, upper tier: first recorder or defense judge, second middle magistrate, third upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 中甲，初上簿，二下令，三中令。

translations.literal: Middle tier: first upper registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Middle tier: first upper registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate.

sentences.zh: 下甲，初中簿，二錄事、防判、三中令。

translations.literal: Lower tier: first middle registrar, second recorder or defense judge, third middle magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Lower tier: first middle registrar, second recorder or defense judge, third middle magistrate.

sentences.zh: 又詔今後狀元授應奉，一年後所撰文字無過人者與外除。

translations.literal: It was also decreed that thereafter the top graduate was appointed Attendant-in-Waiting; after one year, if his writings showed no exceptional merit, he received external appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The court also decreed that thereafter the top graduate would serve as Attendant-in-Waiting; after one year, if his writings showed no exceptional merit, he would be posted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十六年格，以相次合為令者減一資歷。

translations.literal: Regulations of the twenty-sixth year: those whose consecutive appointments qualified as magistrate reduced one seniority step.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-sixth-year (1186) rules reduced one seniority step for consecutive magistrate appointments.

sentences.zh: 二十六年格，三降兩降免一降，文資 右職外官減最後，上令一任通五任回呈省，遂定格，上甲，初錄事、防判，二中令，三、四、五上令。

translations.literal: Regulations of the twenty-sixth year: three demotions or two demotions exempted one demotion; for civil track, right track, and external officials the last step was reduced; one term as upper magistrate counted through five terms before reporting to the provincial office; then fixed regulations—upper tier: first recorder or defense judge, second middle magistrate, third through fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-sixth-year rules: three demotions or two demotions waived one demotion; civil, military, and external tracks trimmed the final step; one upper-magistrate term counted as five before reporting to the provincial office. Final rules for upper tier: first recorder or defense judge, second middle magistrate, third through fifth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 中甲，初中簿，二下令，三中令，四、五上令，策試進士，初錄事、防判，二、三、四、五上令。

translations.literal: Middle tier: first middle registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate; policy-test jinshi: first recorder or defense judge, second through fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Middle tier: first middle registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate. Policy-test jinshi: first recorder or defense judge, second through fifth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 其次，初上簿，二中令，三、四、五上令。

translations.literal: Next below: first upper registrar, second middle magistrate, third through fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Next tier: first upper registrar, second middle magistrate, third through fifth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 又次，初中簿，二下令，三中令，四、五上令。

translations.literal: Still lower: first middle registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Still lower: first middle registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 下甲，初下簿，二下令，三中令，四，五上令。

translations.literal: Lower tier: first lower registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Lower tier: first lower registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，制進士階至中大夫呈省。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it was regulated that when jinshi reached the rank of Court Gentleman for Guidance they reported to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1187) jinshi reported to the provincial office upon reaching Court Gentleman for Guidance.

sentences.zh: 明昌二年，罷勘會狀元行止之制。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingchang the system of investigating top graduates' conduct was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 2 (1191) the court abolished investigations of top graduates' conduct.

sentences.zh: 七年格，縣令守闕各依舊格注授。

translations.literal: Regulations of the seventh year: county magistrate and vacancy-holding appointments each followed the old regulations for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh-year (1196) rules assigned county magistrate and vacancy-holding posts under the old formulas.

sentences.zh: 泰和格，諸進士及第合授資任須曆遍乃呈省。

translations.literal: Taihe regulations: all jinshi who had passed the examinations and received their proper appointments had to complete the full sequence before reporting to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taihe rules all jinshi had to complete the full appointment sequence before reporting to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 雖未盡曆，官已至中大夫亦呈省。

translations.literal: Even if the sequence was not complete, when rank reached Court Gentleman for Guidance they still reported to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the sequence was incomplete, they reported once they reached Court Gentleman for Guidance.

sentences.zh: 又諸詞賦、經義進士及第後，策試中選，合授資任曆遍呈省，仍每任升本等首銓選。

translations.literal: Also, rhapsody and classical-exegesis jinshi who after passing the examinations were selected in the policy test, after receiving their proper appointments and completing the sequence, reported to the provincial office; each term still advanced them one grade in the primary selection roster.
translations.idiomatic: Rhapsody and classical-exegesis jinshi who passed the policy test after graduation also reported to the provincial office after completing the full sequence, advancing one primary-selection grade each term.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，狀元授奉直大夫，上甲儒林郎，中甲以下授征事郎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou the top graduate received Senior Grand Master of the Palace; upper tier Rulin Lang; middle tier and below Zhengshi Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyou 3 (1215) the top graduate received Senior Grand Master of the Palace; upper tier Rulin Lang; middle tier and below Zhengshi Lang.

sentences.zh: 經義進士。

translations.literal: Classical-Exegesis Jinshi
translations.idiomatic: Classical-Exegesis Jinshi

sentences.zh: 皇統八年，就燕京擬注。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Huangtong, assignments were drafted at Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong 8 (1148) appointments were drafted at Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 六年，與詞賦第一人皆擬縣令，第二人當除察判，以無闕遂擬軍判。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, together with the top rhapsody graduate both were drafted as county magistrate; the second person was to be appointed circuit judge, but because there was no vacancy they were drafted as army judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the top classical-exegesis and rhapsody graduates were both slated for county magistrate; the second graduate was to receive circuit judge, but with no vacancy open he was slated for army judge instead.

sentences.zh: 第二、第三甲隨各人住貫擬為軍判、丞、簿。

translations.literal: Second and third tiers were drafted according to each person's place of residence as army judge, aide, or registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Second and third tiers were assigned army judge, aide, or registrar according to each candidate's home circuit.

sentences.zh: 舊制，《五經》及第未及十年與關內差使，已十年者與關外差使，四十年除下令。

translations.literal: Under the old rules, those who passed the Five Classics and had not yet reached ten years received assignments within the passes; those who had reached ten years received assignments outside the passes; at forty years they were appointed lower magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules, Five Classics graduates within ten years of passing received assignments inside the passes; after ten years they served outside; at forty years they received lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 正隆三年，不授差使，至三十年則除縣令。

translations.literal: In Zhenglong 3 assignment posts were not granted; at thirty years county magistrate was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenglong 3 (1158) assignment posts were suspended; at thirty years graduates received county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 大定二十八年始複設是科，每舉專主一經。

translations.literal: In Dading 28 this subject was first restored; each examination focused on a single classic.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 28 (1188) the examination was restored, with each session devoted to a single classic.

sentences.zh: 女直進士。

translations.literal: Jurchen Jinshi
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen Jinshi

sentences.zh: 大定十三年，皆除教授。

translations.literal: In Dading 13 all were appointed instructors.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 13 (1173) all were appointed instructors.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上甲第二第三人初除上簿，中甲則除中簿，下甲則除下簿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, upper tier second and third graduates were first appointed upper registrar; middle tier received middle registrar; lower tier received lower registrar.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1182) upper-tier second and third graduates began as upper registrar; middle tier as middle registrar; lower tier as lower registrar.

sentences.zh: 大定二十五年，上甲甲首遷四重，餘各遷兩重。

translations.literal: In Dading 25 the top graduate of the upper tier advanced four grades; the rest each advanced two grades.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 25 (1185) the upper-tier top graduate advanced four grades; all others advanced two.

sentences.zh: 第二第三甲授隨路教授，三十月為一任，第二任注九品，第三、第四任注錄事、軍防判，第五任下令。

translations.literal: Second and third tiers were appointed circuit instructors; thirty months per term; on the second term rank nine was assigned; on the third and fourth recorder or army-defense judge; on the fifth lower magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Second and third tiers were appointed circuit instructors for thirty-month terms. Second term: rank nine; third and fourth: recorder or army-defense judge; fifth: lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 尋複令第四任注縣令。

translations.literal: Soon after it was again ordered that the fourth term assign county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the fourth term was set as county magistrate again.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，減一資歷注縣令。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year one seniority step was reduced for appointing county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1186) one seniority step was waived for county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，添試論。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year essay examination was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1188) an essay examination was added.

sentences.zh: 後皆依漢人格。

translations.literal: Thereafter all followed the Han-track regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all followed the Han graduate track.

sentences.zh: 宏詞，上等遷兩官，次等遷一官，臨時取旨授之。

translations.literal: For Grand Rhetoric, upper grade advanced two ranks, lower grade one rank; appointment followed temporary imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: In the Grand Rhetoric examination, upper grade advanced two ranks and lower grade one; appointment followed a special imperial order.

sentences.zh: 恩榜，章宗大定二十九年，敕今後凡五次禦簾進士，可一試而不黜落，止以文之高下定其次，謂之恩榜。

translations.literal: Grace List: in Zhangzong's Dading 29 an edict ordered that thereafter all jinshi who had reached the imperial curtain five times might sit once without dismissal, ranking only by literary merit—called the Grace List.
translations.idiomatic: Grace List: in Dading 29 (1189) Zhangzong decreed that jinshi who had reached the imperial curtain five times could sit once without failing out, ranked only by literary merit—the Grace List.

sentences.zh: 女直人遷將仕，漢人登仕，初任教授，三十月任滿，依本格從九品注授。

translations.literal: Jurchen advanced to Awaiting Assignment; Han received Entering Service; first term as instructor; after thirty months, appointed secondary ninth rank according to the standard regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen graduates advanced to Awaiting Assignment; Han to Entering Service. First term as instructor; after thirty months they received secondary ninth rank under the standard rules.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，敕四舉終場，亦同五舉恩例，直赴禦試。

translations.literal: In Mingchang 1 an edict ordered that those who completed four examinations likewise followed the five-examination grace precedent and went directly to the imperial test.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 1 (1190) the court ruled that four completed examination cycles qualified for the five-cycle grace rule and direct entry to the imperial test.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年，敕神童三次終場，同進士恩榜遷轉。

translations.literal: In Mingchang 5 an edict ordered that child prodigies who completed three examinations followed jinshi Grace List advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 5 (1194) child prodigies who completed three cycles advanced like jinshi on the Grace List.

sentences.zh: 兩次終場，全免差使。

translations.literal: Those who completed two examinations were entirely exempt from assignment posts.
translations.idiomatic: Two completed cycles exempted candidates entirely from assignment posts.

sentences.zh: 第六任與縣令，依本格遷官，如一次終場，初入仕則一除一差。

translations.literal: On the sixth term county magistrate was granted; advancement followed standard regulations; if one examination was completed, on first entry to office one appointment alternated with one assignment.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth term brought county magistrate under standard advancement rules. One completed cycle meant alternating appointment and assignment on first entry.

sentences.zh: 其餘並依本門戶，仍使應二舉，然後入仕。

translations.literal: All others followed their own gateways, still requiring two examinations before entering office.
translations.idiomatic: All others followed their own entry tracks but still had to sit two examinations before entering office.

sentences.zh: 每舉放四十人。

translations.literal: Each examination released forty candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Each session passed forty candidates.

sentences.zh: 凡恩例補廕同進士者，謂大禮補致仕、遺表、陣亡等恩澤，補承襲錄用，並與國王並宗室女為婚者。

translations.literal: All who received jinshi-equivalent yin under grace rules meant great-rite grants for retirement, posthumous memorials, death in battle, and similar favors, supplementary inheritance appointments, and those who married daughters of kings or imperial clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi-equivalent yin under grace rules covered great-rite grants for retirement, posthumous petitions, death in battle, supplementary inheritance appointments, and men who married daughters of kings or imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 正隆二年格，初下簿，二中簿，三上簿，四下令，五中令，六、七上令，回呈省。

translations.literal: Regulations of Zhenglong 2: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third upper registrar, fourth lower magistrate, fifth middle magistrate, sixth and seventh upper magistrate, then report to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenglong 2 (1157) rules: lower registrar, middle registrar, upper registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper-magistrate terms, then report to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 凡特賜同進士者，謂進粟、出使回、歿于王事之類，皆同雜班，補廕亦以雜班。

translations.literal: All specially granted jinshi-equivalent status meant grain contributions, return from missions abroad, death in royal service, and the like; all counted as mixed rank, and supplementary yin also used mixed rank.
translations.idiomatic: Specially granted jinshi status covered grain contributions, return from diplomatic missions, death in royal service, and similar cases—all treated as mixed rank, with mixed-rank yin as well.

sentences.zh: 正隆元年格，初授下簿，二中簿，三縣丞、四軍判，五、六防判。

translations.literal: Regulations of Zhenglong 1: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third county aide or fourth army judge, fifth and sixth defense judge.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenglong 1 (1156) rules: lower registrar, middle registrar, county aide or army judge, then two defense-judge terms.

sentences.zh: 七、八下令，九中令，十上令。

translations.literal: Seventh and eighth lower magistrate, ninth middle magistrate, tenth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh and eighth terms: lower magistrate; ninth: middle magistrate; tenth: upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 尋複更初注下等軍判、丞、簿、尉，次注中等軍判、丞、簿、尉，第三注上等軍判、丞、簿、尉，四下令，五中令，六上令。

translations.literal: Soon after it was changed again: first lower army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; next middle army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; third upper army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; fourth lower magistrate, fifth middle magistrate, sixth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: The rules were soon revised: first lower army judge, aide, registrar, or aide; then middle; then upper; fourth lower magistrate; fifth middle magistrate; sixth upper magistrate.

sentences.zh: 律科、經童。

translations.literal: Legal Studies and Child Classics
translations.idiomatic: Legal Studies and Child Classics

sentences.zh: 正隆元年格，初授將仕郎，皆任司候，十年以上並一除一差，十年外則初任主簿，第二任司候，第三主簿，四主簿，五警判，六市丞，七諸縣丞，八次赤丞，九赤縣丞，十下縣令。

translations.literal: Regulations of Zhenglong 1: first granted Jiangshi Lang, all served as courier station officer; ten years or more alternated one appointment with one assignment; beyond ten years first term section chief, second courier officer, third section chief, fourth section chief, fifth police judge, sixth market aide, seventh various county aides, eighth secondary capital aide, ninth capital county aide, tenth lower-county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenglong 1 rules graduates first received Jiangshi Lang and served as courier officers. After ten years they alternated appointment and assignment: section chief, courier officer, section chief twice, police judge, market aide, county aides, secondary capital aide, capital county aide, lower-county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十一中縣令，五任上縣令，呈省。

translations.literal: Eleventh middle-county magistrate; five terms as upper-county magistrate; report to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh term: middle-county magistrate; five upper-county magistrate terms; then report to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 三年制，律科及第及七年者與關內差使，七年外者與關外差。

translations.literal: Three-year rule: legal graduates who had passed and reached seven years received assignments inside the passes; beyond seven years, assignments outside.
translations.idiomatic: Under the three-year rule, legal graduates within seven years of passing served inside the passes; after seven years, outside.

sentences.zh: 諸經及第人未十年者關內差，已十年關外差。

translations.literal: All classic graduates who had not reached ten years received inside assignments; at ten years, outside assignments.
translations.idiomatic: Classic graduates within ten years served inside the passes; after ten years, outside.

sentences.zh: 律科四十年除下令。

translations.literal: Legal graduates received lower magistrate at forty years.
translations.idiomatic: Legal graduates received lower magistrate after forty years.

sentences.zh: 經童及第人視余人複展十年，然後理算月日。

translations.literal: Child-classics graduates, compared with others, extended another ten years before monthly dates were calculated.
translations.idiomatic: Child-classics graduates waited ten years longer than others before seniority months were counted.

sentences.zh: 大定十四年，以從下新增官階，遂定制，律科及第者授將仕佐郎。

translations.literal: In Dading 14, because new ranks were added at the bottom, regulations were fixed: legal graduates received Jiangshi Assistant Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 14 (1174), with new bottom ranks added, legal graduates received Jiangshi Assistant Lang.

sentences.zh: 十六年特旨，以四十年除下令太遠，其以三十二年不犯贓罪者授下令。

translations.literal: A special order in the sixteenth year held that forty years for lower magistrate was too distant; those who at thirty-two years had committed no corruption were appointed lower magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1176) a special order held forty years too long; graduates with no corruption record at thirty-two years received lower magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十七年，敕諸科人仕至下令者免差。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year an edict ordered that candidates of all subjects who reached lower magistrate were exempt from assignments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1177) graduates of all examination tracks who reached lower magistrate were exempt from assignment posts.

sentences.zh: 二十年，省擬，無贓罪及廉察無惡者減作二十九年注下令，經童亦同此。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the provincial office proposed that those without corruption and with no misconduct on integrity review be reduced to twenty-nine years for lower magistrate; child classics followed the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1180) the provincial office proposed twenty-nine years for lower magistrate if there was no corruption and integrity review found no misconduct; child classics followed suit.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，省擬，以相次當為縣令者減一資歷選注。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the provincial office proposed that those whose consecutive appointments qualified as magistrate reduce one seniority step in selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1186) the provincial office proposed waiving one seniority step for consecutive magistrate appointments.

sentences.zh: 敕命諸科人累任之餘月日至四十二月，准一除一差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for candidates of all subjects, when accumulated surplus months reached forty-two, one appointment alternating with one assignment was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed all-track graduates who accumulated forty-two surplus months to alternate one appointment with one assignment.

sentences.zh: 又敕，舊格六任縣令呈省，遂減為五任。

translations.literal: Another edict: the old rule of six magistrate terms before reporting to the provincial office was reduced to five.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict reduced reporting to the provincial office from six magistrate terms to five.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，減赤縣丞一任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year one capital-county aide term was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1188) one capital-county aide term was dropped.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年，制仕二十六年之上者，如該廉升則注縣令。

translations.literal: In Mingchang 5 it was regulated that those who had served twenty-six years or more, if qualified for integrity promotion, were assigned county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 5 (1194) those with twenty-six years of service who qualified for integrity promotion received county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 六年，減諸縣丞、赤縣丞兩任後吏格，十年內擬注差使，十年外一除一差。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, after reducing two terms of various county aide and capital-county aide under the clerk regulations, within ten years assignment posts were drafted; beyond ten years one appointment alternated with one assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1195), after dropping two county-aide terms from the clerk track, graduates within ten years received assignment posts; beyond ten years they alternated appointment and assignment.

sentences.zh: 若曆八任、或任至三十二年注下令，則免差須遍曆而後呈省。

translations.literal: If they passed eight terms, or reached thirty-two years for lower magistrate, they were exempt from assignments but had to complete the full sequence before reporting to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Eight terms completed, or lower magistrate at thirty-two years, exempted graduates from assignments but required the full sequence before reporting to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 所曆之制，初、二下簿，三、四中簿，五、六、七上簿，犯選格者又曆上簿兩任，八、九則注下令，十中令，十一、十二上令。

translations.literal: The sequence: first and second lower registrar, third and fourth middle registrar, fifth through seventh upper registrar; those who violated selection criteria passed two more upper-registrar terms; eighth and ninth lower magistrate, tenth middle magistrate, eleventh and twelfth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: The sequence ran: two lower registrar terms, two middle, three upper; violators of selection criteria added two upper-registrar terms; eighth and ninth lower magistrate, tenth middle, eleventh and twelfth upper.

sentences.zh: 凡武舉，泰和三年格，上甲第一名遷忠勇校尉，第二、第三名遷忠翊校尉。

translations.literal: For military examinations, regulations of Taihe 3: upper tier first place advanced to Loyal-Brave Commandant; second and third to Loyal-Assistant Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taihe 3 (1203) military rules, upper-tier first place advanced to Loyal-Brave Commandant; second and third to Loyal-Assistant Commandant.

sentences.zh: 中等遷修武校尉，收充親軍，不拘有無廕，視舊格減一百月出職。

translations.literal: Middle tier advanced to Cultivated-Martial Commandant, enrolled in the personal guard, regardless of yin privilege, reducing one hundred months from leaving service under the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Middle tier advanced to Cultivated-Martial Commandant and entered the personal guard, yin or no yin, with one hundred months shaved from the old time-to-office rule.

sentences.zh: 下等遷敦武校尉，亦收充親軍，減五十月出職。

translations.literal: Lower tier advanced to Honest-Martial Commandant, also enrolled in the personal guard, reducing fifty months from leaving service.
translations.idiomatic: Lower tier advanced to Honest-Martial Commandant, also entered the personal guard, with fifty months shaved from time to office.

sentences.zh: 承安元年格，第一名所曆之職，初都巡、副將，二下令，三中令，四、五上令。

translations.literal: Regulations of Cheng'an 1 for first place: first metropolitan patrol officer or deputy commander, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Under Cheng'an 1 (1196) rules for first place: metropolitan patrol officer or deputy commander, then lower, middle, and two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 第二、第三名，初巡尉、部將，二上簿，三下令，四中令，五、六上令。

translations.literal: Second and third place: first patrol aide or company commander, second upper registrar, third lower magistrate, fourth middle magistrate, fifth and sixth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Second and third place: patrol aide or company commander, upper registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 余人，初副巡、軍轄，二中簿，三下令，四中令，五、六上令。

translations.literal: The rest: first deputy patrol or military administrator, second middle registrar, third lower magistrate, fourth middle magistrate, fifth and sixth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: All others: deputy patrol or military administrator, middle registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 凡軍功有六：一曰川野見陣，最出當先，殺退敵軍。

translations.literal: Military merit had six categories: first, meeting the enemy in field or plain, foremost in the van, killing and repelling enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: Military merit had six categories. First: meeting the enemy in open country, leading the van, killing and driving back enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 二曰攻打抗拒州縣山寨，奪得敵樓。

translations.literal: Second: assaulting resistant prefectural, district, and mountain-fort strongholds and capturing enemy towers.
translations.idiomatic: Second: storming resistant prefectural, district, and mountain-fort strongholds and capturing enemy towers.

sentences.zh: 三曰爭取船橋，越險先登。

translations.literal: Third: contesting for boats and bridges, crossing dangers to mount first.
translations.idiomatic: Third: seizing boats and bridges and being first over dangerous ground.

sentences.zh: 四曰遠探捕得喉舌。

translations.literal: Fourth: distant reconnaissance capturing enemy scouts.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: long-range reconnaissance that captured enemy scouts.

sentences.zh: 五曰險難之間，遠處報事情成功。

translations.literal: Fifth: amid hardship and danger, reporting from afar and succeeding in the mission.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: reporting successfully from afar through hardship and danger.

sentences.zh: 六曰謀事得濟，越眾立功。

translations.literal: Sixth: planning affairs to success, surpassing the multitude in achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: planning that succeeded and winning merit beyond the common run.

sentences.zh: 皇統八年格，凡帶官一命昭信校尉正七品以上者，初除主簿及諸司副使正九品，二主簿及諸司使正八品，三下令從七品，四中令正七品，五上令，或通注鎮軍都指揮使正七品及正將。

translations.literal: Regulations of Huangtong 8: all who held office with one command as Zhaoxin Commandant, proper seventh rank and above—first appointed section chief and various bureau deputy commissioners, proper ninth rank; second section chief and various bureau commissioners, proper eighth rank; third lower magistrate, secondary seventh rank; fourth middle magistrate, proper seventh rank; fifth upper magistrate, or throughout appointed garrison army commander, proper seventh rank, and company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Under Huangtong 8 (1148) rules, holders of one command as Zhaoxin Commandant at proper seventh rank or above began as section chief or bureau deputy (rank nine), then section chief or bureau commissioner (rank eight), lower magistrate (secondary seventh), middle magistrate (proper seventh), upper magistrate—or garrison commander and company commander throughout.

sentences.zh: 其官不至昭信及無官者，自初至三任通注丞、簿，四下令，五中令，六上令及知城寨從七品。

translations.literal: Those whose rank did not reach Zhaoxin and those without office: from the first through third terms continually appointed aide or registrar; fourth lower magistrate; fifth middle magistrate; sixth upper magistrate and fortress-prefect, secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those below Zhaoxin rank or without office served three terms as aide or registrar, then lower magistrate, middle magistrate, upper magistrate and fortress-prefect at secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 章宗大定二十九年，遷至鎮國者取旨升除後。

translations.literal: In Zhangzong's Dading 29, those who advanced to Pacifier of the Realm received imperial order for promotion thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 29 (1189) those who reached Pacifier of the Realm required an imperial order for further promotion.

sentences.zh: 吏格之所定，女直人昭信校尉以上者，初下簿，二下令，三中令，四、五上令。

translations.literal: Under the clerk regulations fixed for Jurchen Zhaoxin Commandant and above: first lower registrar, second lower magistrate, third middle magistrate, fourth and fifth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Under clerk regulations, Jurchen at Zhaoxin Commandant and above: lower registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 女直一命遷至昭信校尉、余人至昭信已上者，初下簿，二中簿，三下令，四中令，五、六上令。

translations.literal: Jurchen with one command advanced to Zhaoxin Commandant; others reaching Zhaoxin and above: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third lower magistrate, fourth middle magistrate, fifth and sixth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen with one command who reached Zhaoxin Commandant, and others at Zhaoxin or above: lower registrar, middle registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 凡至宣武將軍以上者，初下令，二中令，二中令，三、四上令。

translations.literal: All who reached Martial-Proclaiming General and above: first lower magistrate, second middle magistrate, second middle magistrate, third and fourth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: All who reached Martial-Proclaiming General and above: lower magistrate, two middle magistrate terms, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 凡勞效謂年老千戶、謀克也。

translations.literal: Merit commendation meant elderly chiliarchs and company commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Merit commendation covered elderly chiliarchs and company commanders.

sentences.zh: 大定五年，制河南、陝西統軍司，千戶十年以上擬從七品，三十年千戶、四十年以上之謀克從八品，二十年以上千戶、三十年以上謀克從九品，二十年以上謀克與正班、與差使，十年以上賞銀絹，皆以所曆千戶、謀克、蒲輦單月日通算。

translations.literal: In Dading 5 regulations fixed for the Henan and Shaanxi commanderies: chiliarchs of ten years or more were drafted for secondary seventh rank; chiliarchs of thirty years and company commanders of forty years or more for secondary eighth rank; chiliarchs of twenty years or more and company commanders of thirty years or more for secondary ninth rank; company commanders of twenty years or more received proper rank and assignments; those of ten years or more received silver and silk rewards—all calculated by total months as chiliarch, company commander, or platoon leader.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 5 (1165) the Henan and Shaanxi commands ruled: ten-year chiliarchs qualified for secondary seventh rank; thirty-year chiliarchs and forty-year company commanders for secondary eighth; twenty-year chiliarchs and thirty-year company commanders for secondary ninth; twenty-year company commanders received proper rank and assignments; ten-year veterans received silver and silk—all by total months served.

sentences.zh: 二十年，制以先曾充軍管押千戶、謀克、蒲輦二十年以上、六十五歲放罷者，視其強健者與差除、令系班，不則量加遷賞。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year regulations fixed that those who had previously served as military escort chiliarchs, company commanders, or platoon leaders for twenty years or more and were released at age sixty-five—if still robust, were given assignment and kept on the roster; otherwise advancement rewards were granted as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1180) veterans who had served twenty years as military escort chiliarchs, company commanders, or platoon leaders and retired at sixty-five, if still fit, received appointment and stayed on the roster; otherwise they received appropriate advancement rewards.

sentences.zh: 後更定吏格，若一命遷宣武將軍以上，當授從七品職事者，初下令，二中令，三、四上令。

translations.literal: Later the clerk regulations were revised: if with one command one advanced to Martial-Proclaiming General and above and should receive secondary seventh-rank functional office, first lower magistrate, second middle magistrate, third and fourth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Later clerk rules held that one-command holders who reached Martial-Proclaiming General and qualified for secondary seventh-rank functional office served lower magistrate, middle magistrate, then two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 官不至宣武，初授八品者授錄事，二赤劇丞，三下令，四中令，五、六上令。

translations.literal: If rank did not reach Martial-Proclaiming and first appointment was rank eight: recorder, second capital-intendant aide, third lower magistrate, fourth middle magistrate, fifth and sixth upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Below Martial-Proclaiming rank with initial rank-eight appointment: recorder, capital-intendant aide, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 初授九品官者，初下簿，二中簿，三上簿，四下令，五中令，六、七上令。

translations.literal: Those with initial rank-nine appointment: first lower registrar, second middle registrar, third upper registrar, fourth lower magistrate, fifth middle magistrate, sixth and seventh upper magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Initial rank-nine appointees: lower registrar, middle registrar, upper registrar, lower magistrate, middle magistrate, two upper magistrate terms.

sentences.zh: 大定九年格，三虞候順德軍千戶四十年以上者與從八品，三十年千戶、四十年以上謀克從九品，二十年以上千戶、三十年以上謀克與正班，以下賞銀絹。

translations.literal: Regulations of Dading 9: three courier officers of Shunde Army—chiliarchs of forty years or more received secondary eighth rank; chiliarchs of thirty years and company commanders of forty years or more secondary ninth rank; chiliarchs of twenty years or more and company commanders of thirty years or more received proper rank; below that, silver and silk rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Under Dading 9 (1169) rules for Shunde Army courier officers: forty-year chiliarchs received secondary eighth rank; thirty-year chiliarchs and forty-year company commanders secondary ninth; twenty-year chiliarchs and thirty-year company commanders proper rank; shorter service brought silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 大定十四年，定隨路軍官出職，以新制從下創添兩重，舊遷忠武校尉者今遷忠勇校尉。

translations.literal: In Dading 14 circuit military officers' leaving service was fixed; with the new system two grades were added at the bottom; those formerly advanced to Loyal-Martial Commandant now advanced to Loyal-Brave Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 14 (1174) circuit military officers' promotion paths were set. With two new bottom grades, former Loyal-Martial Commandant advancement became Loyal-Brave Commandant.

sentences.zh: 中都永固軍指揮使及隨路埽兵指揮使出職，舊遷敦武校尉者今遷進義校尉。

translations.literal: For the capital Ever-Firm Army commander and circuit dike-soldier commanders leaving service, those formerly advanced to Honest-Martial Commandant now advanced to Advancing-Righteousness Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Capital Ever-Firm Army and circuit dike-soldier commanders who had advanced to Honest-Martial Commandant now advanced to Advancing-Righteousness Commandant.

sentences.zh: 武衛軍，大定十七年定制，其猛安曰都將，謀克曰中尉，蒲輦曰隊正。

translations.literal: Imperial Guard Army: regulations fixed in Dading 17; its meng'an was called Chief Commander, company commander Middle Lieutenant, platoon leader Squad Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Guard regulations fixed in Dading 17 (1177): the meng'an was Chief Commander, the company commander Middle Lieutenant, the platoon leader Squad Chief.

sentences.zh: 都將三十月遷一官，至昭信注九品職事。

translations.literal: Chief commanders advanced one rank every thirty months; at Zhaoxin they were assigned rank-nine functional office.
translations.idiomatic: Chief commanders advanced one rank every thirty months and received rank-nine functional office at Zhaoxin.

sentences.zh: 以隊正升中尉。

translations.literal: From squad chief one advanced to middle lieutenant.
translations.idiomatic: Squad chiefs advanced to middle lieutenant.

sentences.zh: 中尉升都將。

translations.literal: Middle lieutenant advanced to chief commander.
translations.idiomatic: Middle lieutenants advanced to chief commander.

sentences.zh: 省令史選之門有四：曰文資，曰女直進士，曰右職，曰宰執子，其出仕之制各異。

translations.literal: There were four gateways to selection as ministry clerk: civil track, Jurchen jinshi, right track, and chancellors' sons; their rules for entering office differed.
translations.idiomatic: Four tracks led to ministry clerk: civil, Jurchen jinshi, military, and chancellors' sons—each with different rules for entering office.

sentences.zh: 文資者，舊惟聽左司官舉用，至熙宗皇統八年，省臣謂：「若止循舊例舉勾，久則善惡不分而多僥倖。

translations.literal: For the civil track, formerly only Left Secretariat officials were permitted to recommend; by Emperor Xizong's Huangtong 8 the provincial ministers said: "If we only follow the old precedent for recommendations, in time good and bad will not be distinguished and opportunism will multiply."
translations.idiomatic: The civil track had relied only on Left Secretariat recommendations. In Huangtong 8 (1148) provincial ministers argued that continuing the old practice would blur merit and invite opportunism.

sentences.zh: 」遂奏定制，自天眷二年及第榜次姓名，從上次第勾年至五十已上、官資自承直郎從六品至奉德大夫從五品，無公私過者，一闕勾二人試驗，可則收補，若皆可即籍名令還職待補。

translations.literal: They then memorialized fixed regulations: from Tianjuan 2 examination lists, ranking names in order; from the top, selecting those aged fifty or above, official seniority from Chengzhi Lang, secondary sixth rank, through Fengdé Grand Master, secondary fifth rank, without public or private offenses—for each vacancy two were selected for trial; if qualified they were enrolled; if both qualified both were registered and sent back to their posts to await appointment.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed fixed rules: from Tianjuan 2 (1139) examination lists, names ranked in order; candidates fifty or older from Chengzhi Lang (secondary sixth) through Fengdé Grand Master (secondary fifth) without public or private offenses—two per vacancy for trial; qualified candidates were enrolled, or both registered and sent back to await appointment.

sentences.zh: 官至承直郎以上，一考得除正七品以上，從六品以下職事，兩考者除從六品以上、從五品以下。

translations.literal: Those reaching Chengzhi Lang and above: after one evaluation appointed proper seventh rank and above, secondary sixth rank and below functional posts; after two evaluations appointed secondary sixth rank and above, secondary fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: At Chengzhi Lang and above: one evaluation brought proper seventh rank or secondary sixth and below; two evaluations brought secondary sixth and above or secondary fifth and below.

sentences.zh: 奉直大夫從六品以上，一考者除從六品以上。

translations.literal: Fengzhi Grand Master, secondary sixth rank and above: after one evaluation appointed secondary sixth rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhi Grand Master at secondary sixth and above: one evaluation brought secondary sixth and above.

sentences.zh: 從五品以下，兩考者除從五品以上、正五品以下，節運同。

translations.literal: Secondary fifth rank and below: after two evaluations appointed secondary fifth rank and above, proper fifth rank and below; circuit transport the same.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary fifth and below: two evaluations brought secondary fifth and above or proper fifth and below; circuit transport followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 正隆元年，罷是制，止於密院台及六部吏人令史內選充。

translations.literal: In Zhenglong 1 this system was abolished; selection was limited to clerks of the Privy Council, Censorate, and six ministries.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenglong 1 (1156) this system was abolished; clerks were chosen only from the Privy Council, Censorate, and six ministries.

sentences.zh: 大定元年，世宗以胥吏既貪墨，委之外路幹事又不知大體，徒多擾動，至二年，罷吏人而複皇統選進士之制。

translations.literal: In Dading 1 Shizong, because clerks were already corrupt and when sent on external assignments did not understand larger principles but only caused disturbance, by the second year clerks were dismissed and the Huangtong system of selecting jinshi was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 1 (1161) Shizong found clerks corrupt and their external assignments disruptive because they lacked broader judgment. In the second year (1162) he dismissed them and restored the Huangtong jinshi selection system.

sentences.zh: 承直郎以上者，一考正七品，除運判、節察判、軍刺同知。

translations.literal: Those at Chengzhi Lang and above: after one evaluation proper seventh rank, appointed transport judge, circuit-intendant judge, or military commissioner deputy.
translations.idiomatic: At Chengzhi Lang and above: one evaluation brought proper seventh rank as transport judge, circuit judge, or military commissioner deputy.

sentences.zh: 兩考者從六品，除京運判、總府判、防禦同知。

translations.literal: After two evaluations secondary sixth rank, appointed capital transport judge, metropolitan prefectural judge, or defense commissioner deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Two evaluations brought secondary sixth rank as capital transport judge, metropolitan prefectural judge, or defense commissioner deputy.

sentences.zh: 奉直大夫已上，一考者從六品，除同前。

translations.literal: Fengzhi Grand Master and above: after one evaluation secondary sixth rank, appointments as before.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhi Grand Master and above: one evaluation brought secondary sixth rank with the same appointments as before.

sentences.zh: 兩考從五品，除節運副、京總管府留守司判官。

translations.literal: After two evaluations secondary fifth rank, appointed circuit-transport deputy or capital metropolitan prefectural retention-office judge.
translations.idiomatic: Two evaluations brought secondary fifth rank as circuit-transport deputy or capital metropolitan retention-office judge.

sentences.zh: 七年，以散階官至五品亦勾充，不願者聽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year those whose honorary rank reached fifth rank were also selected; those unwilling were permitted to decline.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1167) holders of honorary fifth rank could also be selected; unwilling candidates could decline.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以進士官至承直者眾，遂不論官資但以榜次勾補。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, because many jinshi had reached Chengzhi, official seniority was no longer considered and selection followed only examination rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1171) so many jinshi had reached Chengzhi that selection followed examination rank alone, without regard to seniority.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以外多闕官，論者以為資考所拘，難以升進，乃命不論官資，凡一考者與六品，次任降除正七品，第三任與六品，第四任升為從五品。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because outside the capital many offices were vacant and critics held that seniority requirements hindered advancement, it was ordered that regardless of seniority, after one evaluation rank six was granted; on the next term demoted to proper seventh rank; on the third term rank six again; on the fourth advanced to secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1187), with many vacancies outside the capital and critics arguing seniority rules blocked advancement, the court ignored seniority: one evaluation brought rank six; second term demotion to proper seventh; third term rank six again; fourth term secondary fifth.

sentences.zh: 兩考者與從五品，次任降除六品，第三、四任皆與從五品，五任升正五品。

translations.literal: After two evaluations secondary fifth rank; next term demoted to rank six; third and fourth terms both secondary fifth rank; fifth term advanced to proper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two evaluations brought secondary fifth rank; second term demotion to rank six; third and fourth terms secondary fifth again; fifth term proper fifth.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，以習學知除、刑房知案、及兵興時邊關令史，三十月除隨朝闕。

translations.literal: In Cheng'an 2, trainee case managers, criminal-section case managers, and frontier clerks during military campaigns—after thirty months appointed to court-service vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In Cheng'an 2 (1197) trainee case managers, criminal-section managers, and wartime frontier clerks received court-service vacancies after thirty months.

sentences.zh: 泰和八年，以習學知除十五月以上，選充正知除。

translations.literal: In Taihe 8, trainee case managers of fifteen months or more were selected as full case managers.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 8 (1208) trainee case managers with fifteen months or more were selected as full case managers.

sentences.zh: 一考後理算資考。

translations.literal: After one evaluation seniority was calculated.
translations.idiomatic: After one evaluation seniority was calculated.

sentences.zh: 大安三年，以從榜次則各人所曆月日不齊，遂以吏部等差其所曆歲月多寡為次，收補知除，考滿則授隨朝職。

translations.literal: In Da'an 3, because following examination rank left each person's months uneven, the Ministry of Personnel ranked them by differential in years served, enrolled them as case managers, and after evaluation granted court-service posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Da'an 3 (1211) examination rank alone left service months uneven, so the Ministry ranked candidates by years served, enrolled them as case managers, and after evaluation granted court-service posts.

sentences.zh: 貞祐五年，進士未歷任者，亦得充補，一考者除上縣令，再任上縣令升正七品，如已曆一任任丞簿者，舊制除六品，乃更為正七品，一任回降從七品，再任正七品升六品，如曆兩任丞簿者，一考舊除六品，乃更為正七品，一任回免降，複免正七品一任，即升六品。

translations.literal: In Zhenyou 5, jinshi who had not yet served terms could also be enrolled; after one evaluation appointed upper-county magistrate; on a second upper-county magistrate term advanced to proper seventh rank; if they had already served one term as aide or registrar, under the old rules rank six was appointed, but now proper seventh rank; after one term demoted to secondary seventh rank; on reappointment proper seventh rank advanced to rank six; if they had served two terms as aide or registrar, after one evaluation the old rule appointed rank six, but now proper seventh rank; after one term exempt from demotion, again exempt one proper-seventh-rank term, then advanced to rank six.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyou 5 (1217) jinshi without prior service could also be enrolled. One evaluation brought upper-county magistrate; a second upper-county term advanced to proper seventh rank. One prior aide-or-registrar term had meant rank six under old rules but now proper seventh, then demotion to secondary seventh on return, then proper seventh again and advancement to rank six. Two prior aide-or-registrar terms: one evaluation now brought proper seventh instead of rank six, with demotion waived once and one proper-seventh term waived before advancement to rank six.

sentences.zh: 曾曆令一任者，依舊格六品，再任降除七品，還升從五品。

translations.literal: Those who had once served as magistrate followed the old regulations for rank six; on a second term demoted to rank seven; on return advanced to secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had served one term as magistrate received rank six under the old rules; a second term brought demotion to rank seven; on return they advanced to secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 興定二年，敕初任未滿及歷任者，考滿升等為從七品。

translations.literal: In Xingding 2 an edict ordered that those whose first term was incomplete and those who had served terms, when evaluations were complete, advanced in grade to secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 2 (1218) the court ruled that whether a first term was incomplete or terms had been served, completion of evaluations advanced candidates to secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 初任未滿者爾兩任、未歷任者四任、回升正七品，兩任正七皆免回降。

translations.literal: Those whose first term was incomplete needed two more terms; those who had not served needed four; then advanced to proper seventh rank; two proper-seventh-rank terms were exempt from return demotion.
