translations.idiomatic: Incomplete first terms required two more terms; candidates without prior service required four; then advancement to proper seventh rank, with two proper-seventh terms exempt from return demotion.

sentences.zh: 凡不依榜次勾取者同隨朝升除，俟榜次所及日聽再就補。

translations.literal: All selected not according to examination rank advanced and were demoted like court-service officials; when their rank on the list was reached they were permitted to seek enrollment again.
translations.idiomatic: Those selected out of examination-rank order advanced and were demoted like court-service officials, and could seek re-enrollment when their list rank was reached.

sentences.zh: 興定五年，定進士令史與右職令史同格，考滿未應得從七者與正七品，回降從七一任。

translations.literal: In Xingding 5 it was fixed that jinshi clerks and right-track clerks followed the same regulations; when evaluations were complete those not yet qualified for secondary seventh rank received proper seventh rank; on return demoted to secondary seventh rank for one term.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 5 (1221) jinshi clerks and military-track clerks shared the same rules. After evaluations, those not yet at secondary seventh received proper seventh rank, then one return demotion to secondary seventh.

sentences.zh: 所勾諸府令史不及三考出職者除從七品，回降除八品。

translations.literal: Prefectural clerks selected who left service before three evaluations received secondary seventh rank; on return demoted to rank eight.
translations.idiomatic: Selected prefectural clerks who left service before three evaluations received secondary seventh rank; on return they were demoted to rank eight.

sentences.zh: 若一任應得從七品者除六品，回降正七品，若一任應得正七品者免降。

translations.literal: If after one term they qualified for secondary seventh rank they received rank six; on return demoted to proper seventh rank; if after one term they qualified for proper seventh rank they were exempt from demotion.
translations.idiomatic: One term qualifying for secondary seventh brought rank six, then return demotion to proper seventh. One term qualifying for proper seventh was exempt from demotion.

sentences.zh: 女直進士令史，二十七年格，一考注正七品，兩考注正六品。

translations.literal: Jurchen jinshi clerks: regulations of the twenty-seventh year—after one evaluation appointed proper seventh rank; after two evaluations appointed proper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the twenty-seventh-year (1187) rules, Jurchen jinshi clerks received proper seventh rank after one evaluation and proper sixth after two.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，敕樞密院等處轉省者，並用進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year an edict ordered that those transferred to the ministry from the Privy Council and similar offices all used jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1188) transfers to the ministry from the Privy Council and similar offices were limited to jinshi.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，敕至三考者與漢人兩考者同除。

translations.literal: In Mingchang 1 an edict ordered that those reaching three evaluations received the same appointments as Han candidates with two evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 1 (1190) three evaluations brought the same appointments as two evaluations for Han candidates.

sentences.zh: 明昌三年，罷契丹令史，其闕內增女直令史五人。

translations.literal: In Mingchang 3 Khitan clerks were abolished; within their vacancies five Jurchen clerks were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 3 (1192) Khitan clerks were abolished and five Jurchen clerks added to fill the vacancies.

sentences.zh: 五年，以與進士令史辛苦既同，資考難異，遂定與漢進士一考與從六品，兩考與從五品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because their hardship matched jinshi clerks while seniority requirements differed, it was fixed that like Han jinshi, after one evaluation secondary sixth rank was granted, after two evaluations secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1194), because their service matched jinshi clerks in hardship but not in seniority rules, one evaluation brought secondary sixth rank and two brought secondary fifth—the same as Han jinshi.

sentences.zh: 宰執子弟省令史，大定十二年，制凡承廕者，呈省引見，除特恩任用外，並內奉班收，仍於國史院署書寫、太常署檢討、秘書監置校勘、尚書省準備差使，每三十月遷一重，百五十月出職。

translations.literal: Chancellors' sons as ministry clerks: in Dading 12 it was regulated that all who received yin were presented to the provincial office for audience; except for special-grace appointments, all were enrolled in the inner attendance corps, still serving at the National History Academy as scribes, at the Sacrifices Office as examiners, at the Secretariat as collators, and at the Ministry of State Affairs on preparatory assignments; every thirty months one grade was advanced; at one hundred fifty months they left service.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 12 (1172) chancellors' sons entering ministry clerk service by yin were presented to the provincial office. Except for special appointments, all joined the inner attendance corps while serving as National History scribes, Sacrifices examiners, Secretariat collators, and Ministry preparatory assignees, advancing one grade every thirty months and leaving service at one hundred fifty months.

sentences.zh: 如承應一考以上，許試補省令譯史，則以百二十月出職，其已曆月日皆不紐折，如系終場舉人，即聽尚書省試補。

translations.literal: If they had served as attendants for one evaluation or more, they were permitted trial enrollment as ministry clerks or translators, then left service at one hundred twenty months; months already served were not discounted; if they were examination completers, they were permitted Ministry trial enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants with one evaluation or more could trial-enroll as ministry clerks or translators and leave service at one hundred twenty months without discounting prior months. Examination completers could sit the Ministry trial.

sentences.zh: 十七年，定制，以三品職事官之子，試補樞密院令史。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year regulations were fixed: sons of rank-three functional officials trial-enrolled as Privy Council clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1177) sons of rank-three functional officials could trial-enroll as Privy Council clerks.

sentences.zh: 遂命吏部定制，宰執之子、並在省宗室郎君，如願就試令譯史，每年一就試，令譯史考試院試補外，緦麻袒免宗室郎君密院收補。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel was then ordered to fix regulations: chancellors' sons and imperial-clan attendants at the ministry, if willing to sit clerk and translator examinations, tested once yearly; apart from clerk and translator examination enrollment, distant-mourning and upper-garment imperial-clan attendants were enrolled by the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry then fixed rules: chancellors' sons and imperial-clan attendants at court could sit annual clerk and translator examinations. Beyond examination enrollment, distant- and upper-garment imperial-clan attendants were enrolled by the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 大定二十八年，制以宗室第二從親並宰相之子，出職與六品外，宗室第三從親並執政之子，出職與正七品。

translations.literal: In Dading 28 it was regulated that imperial-clan second collateral kin and chancellors' sons, on leaving service, received rank six and above; imperial-clan third collateral kin and chief councillors' sons received proper seventh rank on leaving service.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 28 (1188) second-collateral imperial clansmen and chancellors' sons left service at rank six or above; third-collateral clansmen and chief councillors' sons at proper seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 其出職皆以百五十月，若見已轉省之餘人，則至兩考止與正七品。

translations.literal: All left service at one hundred fifty months; if they were among others already transferred to the ministry, then up to two evaluations they received only proper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: All left service at one hundred fifty months. Those already transferred to the ministry received only proper seventh rank through two evaluations.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，四從親亦許試補。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year fourth-collateral kin were also permitted trial enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1189) fourth-collateral imperial clansmen were also permitted trial enrollment.
